title: Act: Check scene characters in validateWorld
summary: Add the scene character reference check inside the per-scene loop of validateWorld
description: In game/src/content/loader.ts validateWorld, inside the for (const scene of world.scenes) loop, iterate scene.characters ?? [] with index and push a path-tagged error for ids not in the existing characters Set.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown scene character ids push scenes[<sceneId>].characters[<index>].id: unknown character <id>
Known ids and scenes without characters push nothing
definition_of_done: validateWorld reports unknown scene character ids

steps.action: Inside the scene loop, after the dialogue loop (after L140) and before the objects loop, add a loop over (scene.characters ?? []) with index i that pushes an error when !characters.has(character.id).
steps.expected: validateWorld returns the path-tagged message for each scene character id missing from world.characters
